description: React component for managing team member permissions, including fetching, displaying, editing, and saving permissions with UI elements from Tremor and Ant Design.

classes.name: MemberPermissionsProps
classes.description: Props interface for MemberPermissions component, including teamId, accessToken, and canEditTeam.

methods.name: fetchPermissions
methods.description: Fetches permissions for the team and updates component state.

methods.name: handlePermissionChange
methods.description: Handles toggling of individual permission checkboxes.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Saves the updated permissions to the backend.

methods.name: handleReset
methods.description: Resets permissions to last fetched state.
